transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I hope I'm explaining this right, and I really don't want to come across as difficult to work with or, you know, like a diva or anything. I try really hard to get along with everyone. 

But I guess I'm here because... well, for almost two years now, ever since this one big commission, I've just been unable to shake this certainty about my ensemble. It's just a few people in the group, really, but they've started using things like sudden schedule changes, seating choices, and just these little comments in rehearsals to quietly undermine my work. 

And, I mean, they'll show me emails or notes that supposedly explain it all away, and I always smile and try to be agreeable about it, but... I just know what they're actually doing. I'm sorry, does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm handling it the right way, because it's been really stressful.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds when no one was around, that others couldn't hear?

No, no, I haven't experienced anything like that. I mean, I have a good ear for music, obviously, but I don't hear things that aren't there. I know that probably sounds like a strange thing to say, but I just want to be completely honest with you. I hope that's the kind of answer you were looking for? I really don't want to waste your time with things that aren't happening.
Outside of this situation with your ensemble, do you tend to feel suspicious or distrustful of other people in your life, like close friends or family?

Oh, no, definitely not. Um, my friends and family are wonderful. I trust them completely. I'm actually a very open person usually, or at least I really try to be. 

It's really just... just this specific group in the ensemble. I don't walk around suspicious of people in general, I promise. I really hope that doesn't make me sound inconsistent? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture, because I really do value my personal relationships and I always try my best to be a good friend to people. Does that help explain things a bit better?

latest_inference.note: Ruled out F60.0 as distrust is circumscribed and not pervasive across personal life or contexts. Ruled out F20.0 given absence of hallucinations or other core schizophrenic features, leaving F22 (delusional disorder).
